props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context: the cached client, the schema, the site url and the preferences the card reads through.

props.name: client
props.meaning: A client, for an app with no context. One context is built per client and shared.

props.name: row
props.meaning: A row you already read. Given, the card reads nothing.

props.name: entity
props.meaning: The row to read, when no row is given.

props.name: fields
props.meaning: Field paths for the grid, in order. Dotted paths allowed. Card only.

props.name: variant
props.meaning: The stacked surface, or the thumbnail-first tile.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Thumbnail 16, 16 and 24, with the gaps and name scale to match.

props.name: image_path
props.meaning: The image field the thumbnail comes from.

props.name: label_field
props.meaning: Field shown as the name. Tile only.

props.name: sub_label_field
props.meaning: The left of the tile’s metadata line: a path, or a resolved column so it renders by type.

props.name: sub_label
props.meaning: The caller’s own sub-label. Wins over `subLabelField`.

props.name: secondary_field
props.meaning: The right of the tile’s metadata line: a path, or a resolved column so it renders by type.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: The caller’s own text on the right of the metadata line. Wins over `secondaryField`.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Show the row’s `code` beside the name when the two differ. Tile only.

props.name: statuses
props.meaning: `Status` rows by code (probe 010).

props.name: selectable
props.meaning: Draws the tile’s selection checkbox and gives the tile a focus ring.

props.name: selected
props.meaning: Whether the tile is taken.

props.name: site_url
props.meaning: The site the name and every linked row point at.

props.name: hours_per_day
props.meaning: The site's working day. Durations then render in days.

props.name: locale
props.meaning: Used for dates and numbers.

props.name: time_zone
props.meaning: IANA zone a `date_time` is shown in.

props.name: frame_rate
props.meaning: Frames a second. A timecode then carries its frame digits.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: What a field with no value shows.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

slots.name: actions
slots.draws: The thumbnail's top-right corner, on hover or focus. Tile only.

keyboard.does: On a card, moves to the name, when a site url is known, then to any link inside a field value. On a tile, moves to the checkbox and to the actions.
Opens the row's page on the site, in a new tab.
Toggles the checkbox it is on.
